selection.ownership: Certifier sp. z o.o., Kraków, Poland (KRS 0000863560). International digital-credential REST at api.certifier.io, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Certifier REST Bearer access token plus required Certifier-Version 2022-10-26, GET /v1/groups /designs /credentials /credential-interactions with limit/cursor pagination, Certifier sp. z o.o. Kraków identity, and dated incident search (Certifier + certifier.io + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. EuroCert ransomware coverage is a distinct Polish qualified-signature company. No current unresolved Certifier.io compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Certifier REST uses Bearer access tokens and Certifier-Version 2022-10-26 on https://api.certifier.io/v1. GET groups/designs/credentials/credential-interactions confirmed on 2026-09-13. Operator is Certifier sp. z o.o. (Kraków, Poland). Dated incident search found no qualifying unresolved Certifier.io compromise. EuroCert is a distinct company.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /v1/groups?limit=1 used by the pinned validator.
Native sends Authorization Bearer and the required Certifier-Version 2022-10-26 header. The upstream user-agent is not sent.
Native category is productivity (source Communication is not in Rust CATEGORIES).
Returns raw Certifier JSON under data instead of the source {groups, pagination} wrapper.
Maps to official GET /v1/groups. Optional limit (1-100) and cursor match Certifier cursor pagination. Returns raw Certifier JSON under data.
Maps to official GET /v1/designs. Optional limit and cursor. Returns raw Certifier JSON under data.
Maps to official GET /v1/credentials. Optional limit and cursor. POST /credentials/search and create-issue-send writes are omitted. Returns raw Certifier JSON under data.
Maps to official GET /v1/credential-interactions. Optional credentialId, limit, and cursor are forwarded as query parameters matching the pinned source. Returns raw Certifier JSON under data.
Maps to official GET /v1/groups/{id}. Groups are still addressed at /groups while Certifier docs rename them credential templates.
Maps to official POST /v1/groups. New integrations send designIds rather than the legacy certificateDesignId/badgeDesignId fields.
Maps to official PATCH /v1/groups/{id}.
Maps to official DELETE /v1/groups/{id} (204).
Maps to official GET /v1/designs/{id}.
Maps to official GET /v1/credentials/{id}.
Maps to official POST /v1/credentials with recipient.name and recipient.email.
Maps to official PATCH /v1/credentials/{id}.
Maps to official DELETE /v1/credentials/{id}.
Maps to official POST /v1/credentials/search. Optional status, groupId, and recipientEmail are folded into a simple AND filter.
Maps to official POST /v1/credentials/{id}/issue.
Maps to official POST /v1/credentials/{id}/send. deliveryMethod defaults to email when omitted.
Maps to POST /v1/credentials/create-issue-send, the all-in-one create/issue/send endpoint.
Maps to official GET /v1/attributes.
Maps to official GET /v1/credentials/{id}/design-templates.
